title: Our brand strategy
slide_intent: Separate the organization’s reason for existing from its proposed action and supporting evidence. Readers can trace a claim to the material offered in its support.
strategic_value: Frontline AIDS can give teams a common explanation of why it exists and how its movement approaches barriers to care.
demonstration: On cyan, three ruled rows label purpose, proposition and proof points. Proof points occupy the deepest row.
practical_value: Choose the appropriate level when writing a statement of intent, an explanation of the work or a supporting example.

content_islands.name: Navigation and introduction
content_islands.spec: Place the section rail at left, then the heading and short framing paragraph.

content_islands.name: Strategy rows
content_islands.spec: In the right field give each row a bold label and a corresponding text block. Separate the three entries with horizontal rules.
